title: Continental Golf Club (Scottsdale)
gap: Price for public tee times not stated
blurb: Continental Golf Club offers a par-60 executive golf course designed by Greg Nash and Jeff Harbin, featuring tree-lined fairways, sculpted greens, and water features. The club provides a vibrant community with year-round events, leagues, and world-class instruction. It also hosts Glow Golf, a night golf experience with glowing balls and festive events.
